table_mode: setting_values is SQLite STRICT and participates in LLD-01 exact-schema/FK-index verification.

table.name: setting_values
table.purpose: persist only explicit writes for code-defined typed settings; absent settings remain absent
columns: revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: setting_key must exist in closed SettingDefinitionRegistry before read/write interpretation
contract_name/version must match registered definition or an explicit registered upgrader path
value_json is parsed/validated through LLD-01 strict JSON contract before persistence
unknown setting keys are rejected with SETTING_UNKNOWN

unsupported persisted/requested contract versions are rejected with SETTING_CONTRACT_MISMATCH unless an explicit registered upgrader accepts the exact origin; Beta 1.0 defines no generic quarantine store/path
reading absent setting returns code-defined default without inserting a row

ordinary settings storage excludes passwords, verifier material, encryption keys, run-auth tokens, device credentials, unrestricted Communication bodies/provider payloads and complete domain-object copies
every accepted semantic change uses base revision/equivalent precondition and LLD-01 authoritative receipt + audit boundary; semantic no-change follows algorithms/no-change.json
semantic_owner validates business meaning; LLD-02 registry/persistence does not become domain authority
storage_class for setting_values is ordinary_nonsecret; secret-bearing definitions are rejected from this registry and belong to LLD-12

upgrade_rule: A registered upgrader parses/validates the exact old version, produces/validates the new version, then performs an explicit UPDATE of value_json/contract_version/revision/command_id atomically in one UnitOfWork. Failure preserves prior bytes/value; SQL REPLACE is forbidden.
index_dependency: schema/fk-index-coverage.json provides required leading-prefix index for setting_values.command_id.
